# Pitch Value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PitchValue`](gmeow-PitchValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PitchValue>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A frame-relative musical pitch — an exact rational ratio or a cents offset expressed relative to an explicit [`TuningSystem`](gmeow-TuningSystem.md). Pitch letters (C4, F#) are projections, not canonical values ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:PitchExpression`](gmeow-PitchExpression.md)
